posts.title: A chiller swapped over one weekend
posts.excerpt: Pieter de Graaf’s team lifted a new chiller onto the Maasoever energy-centre roof on a Saturday morning. Cooling was back on Sunday at 16:00.
posts.content:
The old chiller on the Maasoever energy-centre roof had reached the end of its life, and the campus could not be without cooling for a working week. Pieter de Graaf’s team planned the swap for a weekend instead.

A mobile crane arrived at first light on Saturday. Two engineers guided the new unit down on tag lines, the pipework was reconnected by noon, and the commissioning readings were logged to the site’s asset record. Cooling was back on Sunday at 16:00, before the first office opened on Monday.

posts.title: Night call: a split valve under the library
posts.excerpt: A P1 call at 02:10 and Yusuf Demir on site at 03:05. The archive floor stayed dry and the riser valve was replaced the next day.
posts.content:
At 02:10 the building management system raised a leak alarm on a riser in the basement of the Delft Public Library & Archive. The desk agreed a P1 with the night security officer and called Yusuf Demir, who leads the out-of-hours rota.

He was on site at 03:05, isolated the riser, and kept the archive floor dry. The split valve was replaced the next day, and the closing note reached the library’s facilities contact the same morning.
